summary: Route Usage pane story changes through the UI kit checks that bundle that story.

rules.detail: Adds a required kit input and regression coverage, not an exemption.

compatibility.detail: Generated CI workflows now include the Usage story in the same routing contract as its production data and pane modules.

recovery.detail: Revert the routing and regression updates, regenerate workflows with nix develop .#genie -c genie, and remove this fragment; no stored data changes.
